note: What a server sends to set how long until one of a unit's spells is ready. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots, so that 0 and 1 name those two.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long is left, in seconds.

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The whole cooldown the time left is shown against, taken only where above zero and above timeLeft; otherwise, as for -1, a client keeps its own, replacing it with timeLeft only where that is larger or the spell was not cooling down.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own. It does not move the slot into the summoner range: a client puts the wait on the slot named, set or clear.

bits.name: speakWhenReady
bits.note: Set where the unit says something once the wait is over.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long is left, in seconds. A client counts down from it.

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The length the client shows that remainder against, in seconds: 20 left out of 40 shows the wait half run.
